task.title: Troubleshooting
task.shortdesc: If you can't see anyone, run Connection check to find what needs attention on this phone, then test with a friend.

step.info: You can also tap Having trouble? Check connection at the bottom of Nearby.

step.cmd: Read the result and follow any steps it shows.

chrow.chdesc: This phone is ready. Test with a friend next.
Fix the items listed on the screen, then run the check again.

choption.msgph: Nearby cannot work on this phone yet.

chrow.chdesc: Nearby can't start until the listed problem is fixed.

step.cmd: To check two phones together, open SettingsHelpTest with a friend and follow the steps on both phones.

taskbody.postreq: Still stuck? Open SettingsHelpSend a problem report to share the app's log. Nothing leaves your phone unless you share it.
